posts.text: Here’s the full concall summary Jindal Drilling & Industries — Q1 FY27 Concall Summary (Aug 10, 2026) 1. Quarter Overview Q1 FY27 was a fairly good quarter. Key update: received a new ONGC contract for one of its rigs. That rig is under refurbishment in the UAE, expected to be deployed by October 2026. 2. Order Book & Rig Status Order book: ₹1,310 crores (bifurcated year-wise in the presentation). 3 rigs will be dehired (contract ending) within this financial year.
